analyst.summary: Clean Science & Technology is a debt-free, high-margin specialty chemicals maker with global leadership positions in several niche products. FY26 margins remain strong (37% operating margin) but growth has slowed and margins compressed somewhat during the year versus year-ago levels, likely reflecting industry-wide pricing pressure. We rate it a Hold: an excellent-quality balance sheet and margin profile, but growth needs to reaccelerate to justify paying up further.
